execution_contract: Immutable original training/baseline_config.json plus explicit operations/continuation_24m.json; continuation receipts under runs/A_seed17_24M
title: Asymmetric Offline Process-Reward Adaptation for Mathematical RL
train_dataset: MATH train excluding fixed 500-problem validation split
offline_buffer_source: same frozen initial actor; same fixed buffer across comparisons
offline_buffer_admission: complete, reliably parsed, verifiably correct or incorrect; exclude truncation and ambiguous parsing
anchor_decontamination: exclude validation, test, and ProcessBench questions by ID and normalized text
formal_budget_status: User amended every planned run from 6M to 24M after A/seed17 6M completed and was evaluated; retain fixed 6M, 12M and 24M cumulative milestones; only A/17 continuation is queued. Pilot, evaluation and PRM costs are separate.
test_primary: MATH500 single-generation accuracy, subject to checkpoint-corpus overlap audit
mechanism_test: secondary evaluation on fixed ProcessBench MATH solutions; all B/C/D reward models score the same solutions; no tuning
main_checkpoint: final 24M cumulative completion-token checkpoint; intermediate 6M and 12M checkpoints are retained, not selected by test score
first_48h_goal: verify the C/D loss switch, parse/step-boundary plumbing, nonempty success/failure buffer classes, data manifests and overlap audit, and measured memory/throughput/truncation; no efficacy claim
test_supplementary: full MATH test, exposure-aware and not a clean generalization claim
test_primary_overlap_audit_status: MATH500 and GSM8K have zero exact normalized question overlap with the pinned public PRM800K 12000-question inventory; unknown inherited pretraining exposure and paraphrases remain unverified
prm_batch_matching_C_D: Same failure, success, anchor batches; same updates and optimizer; successful-trajectory term has coefficient 1 in C and 0 in D
known_dataset_risk: PRM800K includes 4,500 original MATH test problems in its extended training split; new-anchor deduplication does not remove inherited PRM exposure
policy_evaluation: shared initial policy plus 6M, 12M and final 24M milestones; same prompt, greedy decoding, length cap and verifier; no PRM reranking or voting
primary_estimand: mean paired-seed D minus C single-generation accuracy on the audited MATH500 evaluation set
secondary_policy_contrasts: each final policy minus the shared initial policy
paired_seed_scope: seeds 17, 42, 83 apply to PRM adaptation and actor initialization, data shuffling and torch RNG; pinned TRL colocated vLLM engine uses seed 0; C/D adaptation uses matched seeds; fixed buffer and anchor manifest shared across all seeds
uncertainty: 95% paired question-cluster bootstrap, resampling each question with all arm/seed predictions together; also report each paired-seed difference and training-seed mean/std; question interval does not fully characterize training randomness
practical_interpretation: positive D-C supports the loss change in this setting; D-A/B establish practical benefit; lower scores or PRM metrics alone do not establish improved policy reasoning; small or inconsistent gains are inconclusive

full_subset: first-error localization accuracy on error-containing solutions
harmonic mean of these two rates
mechanism_metrics.valid_chain_score: minimum correctness probability over native step boundaries
mechanism_metrics.purpose: test whether answer-correct valid and invalid reasoning are better ranked; a common strictly increasing score transform cannot improve AUROC
mechanism_metrics.limitations: AUROC neither proves causal mediation of policy gains nor excludes reward-scale effects in RL; no PRM outputs have yet been evaluated
mechanism_metrics.audit_and_reporting: report class counts and known overlap; if either class is empty after audit, report AUROC unavailable; no test-based threshold or checkpoint selection
mechanism_metrics.uncertainty: Paired question-cluster bootstrap for PRM differences; group multiple solutions and all PRM variants/seeds for the same problem. Report valid/invalid counts in each known-overlap stratum; mark AUROC unavailable if either class is empty.
mechanism_metrics.interpretation: Secondary, overlap-aware mechanism evidence. The 500-solution answer-correct AUROC subset is not a much larger independent clean test set, and higher PRM metrics do not establish policy improvement.

phase_order: continue already authorized A/17 run without changing configuration
freeze buffer, anchors, PRM adaptation settings, step splitter and diagnostics; measure B/C/D pilot throughput
prioritize matched C/D pairs, followed by remaining A/B runs under the same 24M target and paired seed list
complete prespecified arms and seeds within measured resource envelope; disclose unfinished runs without selectively dropping unfavorable seeds
policy-only evaluation, overlap-aware PRM diagnostics and paired statistics
replication_policy: complete all predeclared arms and seeds if the frozen resource envelope permits; do not select seeds or extend only D based on observed accuracy
resource_fallback: if the hardware-only pilot exceeds resources, lower common token/update budgets before formal runs, preserving all four arms and paired seeds; disclose revisions and measured cost
continuation_comparison_policy: Record and match the 6M checkpoint/resume boundary across subsequent arms and seeds. The original checkpoint restores policy, optimizer, scheduler, data progress and Python/NumPy/torch RNG; vLLM separate engine RNG was not saved and restarts at engine seed 0.

budget_amendments.reason: User instruction to extend each run to 24M while preserving 6M/12M/24M results
budget_amendments.known_at_amendment: A/17 6M training and evaluation completed; this is not represented as a predeclared 24M budget from the start

grpo_scaling_interpretation.formal_setting: group; retained in all four arms, including the existing outcome-only continuation
grpo_scaling_interpretation.same_outcome_valid_group: A_i = (m_i - mean(m)) / (sample_std(m) + 5e-4), since lambda=0.2 and epsilon=1e-4
grpo_scaling_interpretation.meaning: The 0.2 coefficient preserves correct-versus-wrong reward ordering but does not cap normalized PRM advantages. Equality to standardized process scores is approximate when ignoring epsilon, not exact.
grpo_scaling_interpretation.supported_alternative: Pinned TRL 0.23.1 supports scale_rewards=False or none; this option is verified but not enabled in the formal comparison.
grpo_scaling_interpretation.no_silent_change: Do not change scaling during the current A continuation or only in B/C/D. Any future scaling ablation is separately specified, budgeted and paired.

reward_diagnostics_plan.status: planned; does not claim B/C/D instrumentation or scoring has been executed
reward_diagnostics_plan.invalid_handling: Also flag groups containing truncated/unparseable outputs; report valid-only strata so same-outcome algebra is not confused with invalid-response penalties.
report_per_stratum: outcome reward and PRM-score means/standard deviations
reward_diagnostics_plan.stratum_basis: Use outcome labels, not combined reward variation. A mixed_reward_groups counter from an outcome-only runner cannot be reused as the outcome-type classifier once process rewards are added.
reward_diagnostics_plan.observational_limitation: Group-conditioned training diagnostics describe exposure; they do not isolate causal effects of training only on that group.

step_segmentation_plan.formal_rule: Freeze the native double-newline splitter and PRM boundary extraction before any B/C/D formal run; same rule for B/C/D and C/D buffer scoring.
records: empty or invalid score sequence indicator
step_segmentation_plan.no_delimiter_behavior: Score a complete nonempty delimiter-free response as one native step, appending the model-card separator for scoring. Do not silently turn it into a long synthetic list of token chunks.
step_segmentation_plan.risk: A fixed splitter does not prevent the policy from avoiding delimiters; track this failure mode and PRM reward versus answer correctness.
step_segmentation_plan.change_policy: No adaptive splitter changes during a formal run. Any alternate splitting rule requires a separate matched sensitivity study; no efficacy claim from monitoring alone.

prm_only_control_S.loss: L_step; both weak outcome terms have coefficient zero
prm_only_control_S.contrast_D_minus_S: added failure weak supervision at fixed anchor adaptation
prm_only_control_S.contrast_S_minus_B: anchor-only adaptation relative to original frozen PRM
prm_only_control_S.evaluation: Score the same fixed ProcessBench MATH solutions as B/C/D; report costs separately. Do not use diagnostics to choose an adaptation checkpoint.
prm_only_control_S.budget: Extra PRM adaptation and evaluation costs are reported; 12 planned RL runs and 288M completion-token target are unchanged.

statistical_power_plan.planning_not_observed: No C/D predictions exist; the 10% disagreement rate is an illustrative assumption, not a measured project quantity.
statistical_power_plan.approximation: For paired binary differences d in {-1,0,1}, Var(d)=q-delta^2. Near the null, SE approximately sqrt(q/n). MDE approximately (z_.975+z_.8)*sqrt(q/n).
statistical_power_plan.seed_correlation: The single-seed planning calculation is not the MDE of a three-seed mean. Actual uncertainty depends on covariance across seeds within questions. Keep each question across all arms/seeds as one cluster; also report seed dispersion.
actual_reporting: mean paired accuracy difference and question-cluster interval
statistical_power_plan.decision: An interval spanning zero or substantial seed inconsistency is inconclusive, not proof of equivalence. Do not move the primary claim to a more favorable diagnostic after observing results.
statistical_power_plan.extra_benchmarks: GSM8K remains the prespecified transfer evaluation. No new benchmark is silently added to the primary pooled endpoint; any additional set requires contamination audit and a separate stated estimand.

peer_review_amendment.scope: Clarify proposal and prospective analysis before C/D training. No running source/config/checkpoint modification and no new training launch.
unchanged: core loss switch c=1 versus c=0
peer_review_amendment.known_results: A/17 6M baseline has been observed. These amendments are not described as preregistered before baseline results.
